metas.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Movie: Mugen Train
metas.description: Tanjiro, Zenitsu and Inosuke join Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku aboard the Infinity Train to defeat the demon Enmu, who is tormenting passengers in their dreams.

metas.name: Jujutsu Kaisen 0
metas.description: Yuta Okkotsu, haunted by the cursed spirit of his childhood friend Rika, enrolls at Jujutsu High where Gojo trains him to control her power before Geto's war on humanity.

metas.name: Suzume
metas.description: 17-year-old Suzume meets a mysterious young man and accidentally unleashes a calamity, setting off on a journey across Japan to close the doors bringing disaster.

metas.name: One Piece Film: Red
metas.description: Luffy and the Straw Hats attend a concert by pop superstar Uta, who unveils a plan for world peace that hides a darker truth about her past with Shanks.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero
metas.description: The Red Ribbon Army returns with powerful new androids Gamma 1 and Gamma 2, forcing Gohan and Piccolo to step up and protect Pan and the world.

metas.name: SPY x FAMILY CODE: White
metas.description: Loid takes his family on a winter getaway as cover for Operation Strix, but Anya's meddling accidentally triggers events that threaten world peace.

metas.name: HAIKYU!! The Dumpster Battle
metas.description: Karasuno faces rival Nekoma in the long-awaited Dumpster Battle, the ultimate showdown between the two underdog volleyball teams.

metas.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba -To the Swordsmith Village-
metas.description: Tanjiro heads to the Swordsmith Village to repair his sword and reunites with the Mist and Love Hashira as Upper Rank demons close in.

metas.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba -To the Hashira Training-
metas.description: Tanjiro undergoes grueling training under the Stone Hashira while Muzan continues his hunt for Nezuko and Ubuyashiki.

metas.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are pulled into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face Upper Rank demons as the final battle against Muzan begins.

metas.name: My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission
metas.description: Deku, Bakugo and Todoroki join pro heroes worldwide to stop the villainous group Humarize from triggering the Quirk Doomsday.

metas.name: My Hero Academia: You're Next
metas.description: A mysterious fortress appears after the war between heroes and villains, and a man resembling All Might confronts Deku and his friends.

metas.name: BLUE LOCK THE MOVIE -EPISODE NAGI-
metas.description: Apathetic gamer Seishiro Nagi is drawn into soccer by Reo Mikage, and their partnership leads them into the ruthless Blue Lock program.

metas.name: OVERLORD: The Sacred Kingdom
metas.description: The Sacred Kingdom begs the undead Sorcerer King Ainz Ooal Gown for help against the Demon Emperor Jaldabaoth's demi-human army.

metas.name: Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
metas.description: Denji meets the mysterious Reze and faces his deadliest battle yet in a brutal war between devils, hunters and secret enemies.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Super: Broly
metas.description: Goku and Vegeta face Broly, a Saiyan who survived Planet Vegeta's destruction, in a stupendous battle that also draws in Frieza.

metas.name: Attack on Titan: THE LAST ATTACK
metas.description: Eren unleashes the Rumbling to eradicate all life outside the walls, and his former comrades and enemies unite to stop him in this omnibus of the final episodes.
